summary: Implemented TimeElapsedColumn and the finished-time capture logic in rich/progress.py, added the progress.elapsed style, Palette.__rich__, tests (test_time_elapsed_column, test_palette.py, updated test_columns expected output), and a CHANGELOG Unreleased entry. Nothing was committed. Tests were NOT run, per instructions. The test_columns expected output was derived by hand-tracing the clock reads (starting frame elapsed 0:00:37 and 0:00:36; finished frames 0:01:00 and 0:00:45; bar widths 33→25 and 23→16; bar speed 2→1 bytes/s) and checked with regex greps only. It is unverified until the suite runs. Note: the spec's test_columns is in tests/test_progress.py, since tests/test_columns.py tests the Columns layout class.
